$4Stim_MCM_sTargetMode_Help: How the hotkey picks your scene partner: Crosshair - the eligible actor closest to the direction you're facing Proximity - the nearest eligible actor, wherever you're facing
$4Stim_MCM_fMaxDistance_Help: Crosshair: how far to look, and how many degrees either side of your facing still count.
$4Stim_MCM_fCrosshairCone_Help: Crosshair: how far to look, and how many degrees either side of your facing still count.
$4Stim_MCM_fActorRadius_Help: New scenes: the picker lists the NPCs this far around you to add to the scene (the one the hotkey found is already in).
$4Stim_MCM_SetUseIntroScenes_Help: 1 = a new scene with you starts with a scene tagged "intro" (as OStim: standing apart, sitting...), else one tagged "idle". Scenes without you start with any scene that fits.
$4Stim_MCM_NPCSceneDuration_Help: Scenes without you end after this long, in milliseconds (300000 = 5 minutes), if nothing has ended them before. 0 = no limit.
$4Stim_MCM_bResumeScenes_Help: 0 = scenes running when you save end when that save is loaded, and everyone in them is let go and dressed again (as OStim). 1 = they start again (after the loading screen, one by one), with their speed, auto mode, excitement and what was taken off.
$4Stim_MCM_SetResetPosition: NPCs go back where they stood
$4Stim_MCM_SetResetPosition_Help: 1 = when a scene ends, NPCs go back to where they stood before it, like OStim's "Reset position". 0 = they stay where the scene left them (they still step off the scene's spot, so no one is stuck inside someone else).
$4Stim_MCM_fTransitionLead_Help: When a transition moves on to its destination, in seconds before its set length (negative = after it). Transition clips play once (dyn_Activation) and end with about 0.5 s of held last pose (see docs/SCENES.md), so the default 0 moves on as the motion finishes, while the pose is held and before the game starts blending the clip back to the base pose. If the clip ends first anyway, 4Stim moves on the moment it does.
$4Stim_MCM_bLockScenes_Help: 1 = lock everyone in a scene on the scene's spot for the whole scene: nothing can move them (other NPCs walking into them, furniture or walls, slopes, gravity, their AI). If someone gets off the spot anyway, they're put back ("Scene lock:" in 4Stim.log). 0 = off.
$4Stim_MCM_bGuardScenes_Help: 1 = keep NPCs in scenes on the scene: their AI doesn't get to pick its own idles (leaning, smoking, sandbox idles...) while the scene runs, and if a game idle gets in anyway, the scene's animation is played again. Each replay is logged ("Scene guard:" in 4Stim.log).
$4Stim_MCM_bLogAnimEvents_Help: 1 = log every animation event scene actors get in the first 5 s of each scene, to 4Stim.log. For animation authors.
$4Stim_MCM_SetUseFreeCam_Help: The camera in scenes with you: 1 = the free camera (0 = third person). Its speed (the game's fFreeCameraTranslationSpeed, set outright as OStim does), and the field of view during the scene (0 = unchanged). Both are put back when the scene ends.
$4Stim_MCM_SetCameraSpeed_Help: The camera in scenes with you: 1 = the free camera (0 = third person). Its speed (the game's fFreeCameraTranslationSpeed, set outright as OStim does), and the field of view during the scene (0 = unchanged). Both are put back when the scene ends.
$4Stim_MCM_SetFreeCamFOV_Help: The camera in scenes with you: 1 = the free camera (0 = third person). Its speed (the game's fFreeCameraTranslationSpeed, set outright as OStim does), and the field of view during the scene (0 = unchanged). Both are put back when the scene ends.
$4Stim_MCM_SetForceFirstPerson_Help: 1 = first person after every scene. 0 = back to the view you started in.
$4Stim_MCM_SetUseFades: Fade at the start and end
$4Stim_MCM_SetUseFades_Help: 1 = fade to black as scenes with you start and end.
$4Stim_MCM_SetUseAutoFades_Help: 1 = also fade to black when auto mode jumps to another scene in a scene with you (scenes marked "fadeOnEntry" always fade).
$4Stim_MCM_SetEnableFurniture_Help: 0 = never use furniture (OStim's SetEnableFurniture): scenes start right here.
$4Stim_MCM_SetSelectFurniture_Help: 0 = never use furniture (OStim's SetEnableFurniture): scenes start right here. 1 = the picker asks "Where?" (right here or a piece of furniture near). 0 = no question: the scene goes on the nearest furniture any scene fits (OStim's SetSelectFurniture), else right here. "Browse all scenes" is then only in a running scene (the search key).
$4Stim_MCM_SetFurnitureSearchDistance_He: Furniture: when the picker opens, it looks around you for beds, chairs, tables and so on, and lists the scenes that can be played on the nearest of each. Types are defined in F4SE\Plugins\4Stim\Furniture\ (see docs/FURNITURE.md). How far, in OStim's steps: (value + 1) x 100 units, so 15 = 1600 units (fFurnitureRadius, in units, also works). And how far up or down, in units.
$4Stim_MCM_fFurnitureHeight_Help: Furniture: when the picker opens, it looks around you for beds, chairs, tables and so on, and lists the scenes that can be played on the nearest of each. Types are defined in F4SE\Plugins\4Stim\Furniture\ (see docs/FURNITURE.md). How far, in OStim's steps: (value + 1) x 100 units, so 15 = 1600 units (fFurnitureRadius, in units, also works). And how far up or down, in units.
$4Stim_MCM_SetResetClutter_Help: 0 = never use furniture (OStim's SetEnableFurniture): scenes start right here. 1 = the picker asks "Where?" (right here or a piece of furniture near). 0 = no question: the scene goes on the nearest furniture any scene fits (OStim's SetSelectFurniture), else right here. "Browse all scenes" is then only in a running scene (the search key). 1 = loose items around furniture a scene is on (misc items, weapons, books, food...) go back where they lay when the scene leaves it (OStim's SetResetClutter). How far around, in OStim's steps of 100 units.
$4Stim_MCM_SetResetClutterRadius_Help: 0 = never use furniture (OStim's SetEnableFurniture): scenes start right here. 1 = the picker asks "Where?" (right here or a piece of furniture near). 0 = no question: the scene goes on the nearest furniture any scene fits (OStim's SetSelectFurniture), else right here. "Browse all scenes" is then only in a running scene (the search key). 1 = loose items around furniture a scene is on (misc items, weapons, books, food...) go back where they lay when the scene leaves it (OStim's SetResetClutter). How far around, in OStim's steps of 100 units.
$4Stim_MCM_bLogFurniture_Help: 1 = log every object the furniture search looks at (with its model path) and where furniture scenes are placed, to 4Stim.log. For writing and tuning furniture types.
$4Stim_MCM_SetOnlyGayAnimsInGayScenes: Roles for the intended sex only
$4Stim_MCM_SetOnlyGayAnimsInGayScenes_He: Roles (docs/ACTORS.md), as OStim: a scene's roles go only to actors of the right type who have what the role needs (from their actor properties, F4SE\Plugins\4Stim\Actor Properties\). 1 = and only to the sex the role is meant for (OStim's "intended sex only"); 0 = any sex that has what it needs (a woman takes a man's role with a strap-on).
$4Stim_MCM_unrestrictedNavigation_Help: Roles (docs/ACTORS.md), as OStim: a scene's roles go only to actors of the right type who have what the role needs (from their actor properties, F4SE\Plugins\4Stim\Actor Properties\). 1 = and only to the sex the role is meant for (OStim's "intended sex only"); 0 = any sex that has what it needs (a woman takes a man's role with a strap-on). 1 = only the actor type counts (OStim's unrestricted navigation).
$4Stim_MCM_PlayerAlwaysDomStraight_Help: Which role you take in scenes for two (OStim's): 1 = always the first role (dominant) / the second (submissive), with a man and a woman (Straight) or two of the same sex (Gay). Otherwise those with a penis go first.
$4Stim_MCM_PlayerAlwaysSubStraight_Help: Which role you take in scenes for two (OStim's): 1 = always the first role (dominant) / the second (submissive), with a man and a woman (Straight) or two of the same sex (Gay). Otherwise those with a penis go first.
$4Stim_MCM_PlayerAlwaysDomGay_Help: Which role you take in scenes for two (OStim's): 1 = always the first role (dominant) / the second (submissive), with a man and a woman (Straight) or two of the same sex (Gay). Otherwise those with a penis go first.
$4Stim_MCM_PlayerAlwaysSubGay_Help: Which role you take in scenes for two (OStim's): 1 = always the first role (dominant) / the second (submissive), with a man and a woman (Straight) or two of the same sex (Gay). Otherwise those with a penis go first.
$4Stim_MCM_playerSelectRoleStraight_Help: Which role you take in scenes for two (OStim's): 1 = always the first role (dominant) / the second (submissive), with a man and a woman (Straight) or two of the same sex (Gay). Otherwise those with a penis go first. 1 = the picker asks which role you take, with a man and a woman, two of the same sex, or three or more.

Otherwise those with a penis go first. 1 = the picker asks which role you take, with a man and a woman, two of the same sex, or three or more.

$4Stim_MCM_futaUseMaleRole_Help: Futa (OStim's): actors who aren't men but have a penis (an actor property gives them one, e.g. for wearing an equippable penis; docs/ACTORS.md). 1 = they can take men's roles, gain excitement at the male rate, and climax as men (for SetEndOnOrgasm).
$4Stim_MCM_futaUseMaleExcitement: Futa excitement at the male rate
$4Stim_MCM_futaUseMaleExcitement_Help: Futa (OStim's): actors who aren't men but have a penis (an actor property gives them one, e.g. for wearing an equippable penis; docs/ACTORS.md). 1 = they can take men's roles, gain excitement at the male rate, and climax as men (for SetEndOnOrgasm).
$4Stim_MCM_futaUseMaleClimax_Help: Futa (OStim's): actors who aren't men but have a penis (an actor property gives them one, e.g. for wearing an equippable penis; docs/ACTORS.md). 1 = they can take men's roles, gain excitement at the male rate, and climax as men (for SetEndOnOrgasm).
$4Stim_MCM_unequipStrapOnIfNotNeeded_Hel: Strap-ons (equip objects of type "strapon", docs/ACTORS.md): on when a woman without a penis takes a role that needs one. 1 = off again in any role that doesn't; 0 = only in one that needs a vagina.
$4Stim_MCM_alignmentGroupBySex_Help: Alignments made in the HUD's Align tab are kept per set of actors, as in OStim: grouped by sex (a man and a woman share one, two women have their own), by height (the actor's scale), and by heel height (High Heels System heels, docs/SCALING.md). Saved to Documents\My Games\Fallout4\4Stim\alignment.json.
$4Stim_MCM_alignmentGroupByHeight_Help: Alignments made in the HUD's Align tab are kept per set of actors, as in OStim: grouped by sex (a man and a woman share one, two women have their own), by height (the actor's scale), and by heel height (High Heels System heels, docs/SCALING.md). Saved to Documents\My Games\Fallout4\4Stim\alignment.json.
$4Stim_MCM_alignmentGroupByHeels_Help: Alignments made in the HUD's Align tab are kept per set of actors, as in OStim: grouped by sex (a man and a woman share one, two women have their own), by height (the actor's scale), and by heel height (High Heels System heels, docs/SCALING.md). Saved to Documents\My Games\Fallout4\4Stim\alignment.json.
$4Stim_MCM_SetSchlongBending_Help: Penis bend (docs/ALIGNMENT.md), as OStim's schlong bending: each role's penis bent up or down in SoS steps (-9 to +9), from the scene, the Align tab, or the animation. 1 = no bending (OStim's SetSchlongBending).
$4Stim_MCM_fPenisBendStep_Help: Penis bend (docs/ALIGNMENT.md), as OStim's schlong bending: each role's penis bent up or down in SoS steps (-9 to +9), from the scene, the Align tab, or the animation. 1 = no bending (OStim's SetSchlongBending). Degrees per step (negative if + bends it down), the skeleton node turned (ZeX's), and the node's own axis it turns around (0 x, 1 y, 2 z).
$4Stim_MCM_iPenisBendAxis: Penis bend axis (0 x, 1 y, 2 z)
$4Stim_MCM_iPenisBendAxis_Help: Penis bend (docs/ALIGNMENT.md), as OStim's schlong bending: each role's penis bent up or down in SoS steps (-9 to +9), from the scene, the Align tab, or the animation. 1 = no bending (OStim's SetSchlongBending). Degrees per step (negative if + bends it down), the skeleton node turned (ZeX's), and the node's own axis it turns around (0 x, 1 y, 2 z).
$4Stim_MCM_bDisableEyeLook_Help: OStim's eye directions (scene actors' lookUp / lookLeft): the face skeleton's eye bones turned this many degrees at 100, sideways and up / down. 1 = off. Other bone names for other face skeletons.
$4Stim_MCM_fLookMaxSide_Help: OStim's eye directions (scene actors' lookUp / lookLeft): the face skeleton's eye bones turned this many degrees at 100, sideways and up / down. 1 = off. Other bone names for other face skeletons.
$4Stim_MCM_fLookMaxUp_Help: OStim's eye directions (scene actors' lookUp / lookLeft): the face skeleton's eye bones turned this many degrees at 100, sideways and up / down. 1 = off. Other bone names for other face skeletons.
$4Stim_MCM_SetScaling_Help: 0 = actors in a scene are scaled to the size the animation was made for (their own NPC height evened out), and heels (High Heels System) are handled, as OStim does (docs/SCALING.md). 1 = they keep their own scale.
$4Stim_MCM_bEnableHUD_Help: The in-scene HUD. 1 = on, 0 = off (the hotkey then opens the scene's navigation in the picker instead).
$4Stim_MCM_sHUDControls_Help: HUD controls, while it has the keys: Tabs    - Up / Down move in the list, Left / Right change tabs Columns - OStim's: Up / Down move in the list, Left / Right move between the list and the tab buttons (Up / Down then pick a tab). On the Align tab, Left / Right still change a value. LB / RB change tabs either way. On a controller, B goes from the list to the tab buttons (Up / Down pick a tab, A goes back to the list), and B again hides the HUD while the scene goes on; A shows it again.
$4Stim_MCM_sTheme_Help: HUD theme: a file name in Data\Interface\4Stim\Themes\, without .json. Built in: Color, PipBoy. See HUD_API.md to make your own.
$4Stim_MCM_bEnableExcitement_Help: Every actor in a scene has an excitement from 0 to 100. It rises with what the scene's actions give them (docs/ACTIONS.md), faster at higher speeds, and only as high as those actions allow (kissing alone stops at 50). Above that it falls back. At 100 the actor climaxes. The HUD's actor meters show it. 1 = on, 0 = off.
$4Stim_MCM_SetsexExcitementMult_Help: Multipliers on how fast men and women get excited.
$4Stim_MCM_SetFemaleSexExcitementMult_He: Multipliers on how fast men and women get excited.
$4Stim_MCM_excitementDecayRate_Help: How fast excitement falls (per second) when the scene gives less than an actor has, and how long it waits before it starts falling (ms).
$4Stim_MCM_excitementDecayGracePeriod_He: How fast excitement falls (per second) when the scene gives less than an actor has, and how long it waits before it starts falling (ms).
$4Stim_MCM_postOrgasmExcitement_Help: After a climax a man starts over at 0. A woman starts at this times the number of climaxes she's had in the scene, up to the max.
$4Stim_MCM_postOrgasmExcitementMax_Help: After a climax a man starts over at 0. A woman starts at this times the number of climaxes she's had in the scene, up to the max.
$4Stim_MCM_SetAutoClimaxAnims_Help: 1 = when an actor climaxes in a scene that has a climax animation for their role (a "climax" scene, see docs/SCENES.md), play it. Otherwise a man's climax drops the scene to its slowest speed.
$4Stim_MCM_endOnPlayerOrgasm_Help: When a scene with the player in it ends after a climax: when the player climaxes, when a man does, when a woman does, or (SetEndOnBothOrgasm=1, overriding the other three) only once everyone has.
$4Stim_MCM_SetEndOnOrgasm_Help: When a scene with the player in it ends after a climax: when the player climaxes, when a man does, when a woman does, or (SetEndOnBothOrgasm=1, overriding the other three) only once everyone has.
$4Stim_MCM_SetEndOnSubOrgasm_Help: When a scene with the player in it ends after a climax: when the player climaxes, when a man does, when a woman does, or (SetEndOnBothOrgasm=1, overriding the other three) only once everyone has.
$4Stim_MCM_SetEndOnBothOrgasm_Help: When a scene with the player in it ends after a climax: when the player climaxes, when a man does, when a woman does, or (SetEndOnBothOrgasm=1, overriding the other three) only once everyone has.
$4Stim_MCM_endNPCSceneOnOrgasm: NPC scenes end at a climax
$4Stim_MCM_endNPCSceneOnOrgasm_Help: 1 = scenes without the player end at their first climax.
$4Stim_MCM_fClimaxEndDelay_Help: Seconds between the climax and the scene ending.
$4Stim_MCM_SetSlowMoOrgasms_Help: What you see at a climax in a scene you're in or watching, the moment it happens: the game in slow motion for 2.5 s, a camera shake (strength, 0 = off), a brief blur (on / off, and how strong, 0-1), a white glow at the screen's edges (0-1, drawn by the HUD), and controller rumble.
$4Stim_MCM_fClimaxShake_Help: What you see at a climax in a scene you're in or watching, the moment it happens: the game in slow motion for 2.5 s, a camera shake (strength, 0 = off), a brief blur (on / off, and how strong, 0-1), a white glow at the screen's edges (0-1, drawn by the HUD), and controller rumble.
$4Stim_MCM_SetBlurOrgasms_Help: What you see at a climax in a scene you're in or watching, the moment it happens: the game in slow motion for 2.5 s, a camera shake (strength, 0 = off), a brief blur (on / off, and how strong, 0-1), a white glow at the screen's edges (0-1, drawn by the HUD), and controller rumble.

$4Stim_MCM_fClimaxFlash_Help: What you see at a climax in a scene you're in or watching, the moment it happens: the game in slow motion for 2.5 s, a camera shake (strength, 0 = off), a brief blur (on / off, and how strong, 0-1), a white glow at the screen's edges (0-1, drawn by the HUD), and controller rumble.
$4Stim_MCM_fClimaxGlowSize_Help: What you see at a climax in a scene you're in or watching, the moment it happens: the game in slow motion for 2.5 s, a camera shake (strength, 0 = off), a brief blur (on / off, and how strong, 0-1), a white glow at the screen's edges (0-1, drawn by the HUD), and controller rumble. How far in from the screen's edges the glow reaches: a share of the screen's smaller side (0.07 = 7%).
$4Stim_MCM_SetUseRumble_Help: What you see at a climax in a scene you're in or watching, the moment it happens: the game in slow motion for 2.5 s, a camera shake (strength, 0 = off), a brief blur (on / off, and how strong, 0-1), a white glow at the screen's edges (0-1, drawn by the HUD), and controller rumble. Scenes with the player (OStim's SetAIControl) / without the player start in it (1) or not (0).
$4Stim_MCM_bAutoModeNPC_Help: Auto mode moves a scene on by itself, like OStim's: every so often it picks a random scene that fits (walking the navigation links when the scene is close enough), sometimes starting with foreplay, sometimes pulling out before a man's climax, and speeds up as excitement rises. Scenes with the player (OStim's SetAIControl) / without the player start in it (1) or not (0).
$4Stim_MCM_autoModeAnimDurationMin_Help: How long auto mode stays in each scene (ms).
$4Stim_MCM_autoModeAnimDurationMax_Help: How long auto mode stays in each scene (ms).
$4Stim_MCM_autoModeForeplayChance_Help: Percent of scenes that start with foreplay (no intercourse), and the excitement at which foreplay ends.
$4Stim_MCM_autoModeForeplayThresholdMin_: Percent of scenes that start with foreplay (no intercourse), and the excitement at which foreplay ends.
$4Stim_MCM_autoModeForeplayThresholdMax_: Percent of scenes that start with foreplay (no intercourse), and the excitement at which foreplay ends.
$4Stim_MCM_autoModePulloutChance_Help: Percent of scenes where a man pulls out before climaxing, and at what excitement.
$4Stim_MCM_autoModePulloutThresholdMin_H: Percent of scenes where a man pulls out before climaxing, and at what excitement.
$4Stim_MCM_autoModePulloutThresholdMax_H: Percent of scenes where a man pulls out before climaxing, and at what excitement.
$4Stim_MCM_navigationDistanceMax_Help: How many navigations auto mode walks through to reach a scene; further scenes are played directly. With autoModeLimitToNavigationDistance=1, once the scene is sexual auto mode only picks scenes it can walk to.
$4Stim_MCM_autoModeLimitToNavigationDist: How many navigations auto mode walks through to reach a scene; further scenes are played directly. With autoModeLimitToNavigationDistance=1, once the scene is sexual auto mode only picks scenes it can walk to.
$4Stim_MCM_bAutoModeStandingOnFloor: Standing off furniture, lying on beds
$4Stim_MCM_bAutoModeStandingOnFloor_Help: 1 = off furniture prefer scenes where someone stands, on a bed scenes where no one does (as OStim), when there are any.
$4Stim_MCM_SetActorSpeedControl_Help: Auto mode speeds the scene up every 2.5-7.5 s (in ms), with a chance from 0 at the lower excitement to certain at the upper one.
$4Stim_MCM_autoSpeedControlIntervalMin_H: Auto mode speeds the scene up every 2.5-7.5 s (in ms), with a chance from 0 at the lower excitement to certain at the upper one.

$4Stim_MCM_autoSpeedControlExcitementMax: Auto mode speeds the scene up every 2.5-7.5 s (in ms), with a chance from 0 at the lower excitement to certain at the upper one.
$4Stim_MCM_bUndress_Help: Scene actors take off their clothes and armor, and put them back on when the scene ends (docs/UNDRESS.md). 1 = on, 0 = off.
$4Stim_MCM_SetAlwaysUndressAtStart_Help: 1 = everything in the undress slots comes off as soon as a scene starts. 0 = only as the scene gets to actions that need it (below).
$4Stim_MCM_SetPartialUndressing_Help: Take off what each scene's actions need as the scene gets there: a kiss takes the hat off, a handjob the gloves...
$4Stim_MCM_SetUndressIfNeed_Help: Actions like intercourse take everything off.
$4Stim_MCM_bRedress_Help: Put it all back on when the scene ends.
$4Stim_MCM_fUndressItemDelay_Help: Seconds between items as they come off and go back on, so actors undress one piece at a time. 0 = all at once (as OStim).
$4Stim_MCM_SetAnimateRedress_Help: 1 = after a scene, NPCs get dressed with redress animations, a body part at a time (torso, feet, hands, head), like OStim, when an animation pack has them (scenes tagged "redress"; the test pack's are OStim's). 0 = their clothes just go back on. The player always dresses without one.
$4Stim_MCM_noFacialExpressions_Help: 1 = no facial expressions (OStim's noFacialExpressions). Expressions are OStim's files (Data\F4SE\Plugins\4Stim\Facial Expressions\), turned into Fallout 4 face morphs by Expression Morphs.json (docs/EXPRESSIONS.md).
$4Stim_MCM_SetExpressionDurationMin_Help: How long an actor keeps a picked expression before picking another, in milliseconds, as OStim's.
$4Stim_MCM_SetExpressionDurationMax_Help: How long an actor keeps a picked expression before picking another, in milliseconds, as OStim's.
$4Stim_MCM_bSounds_Help: 0 = no moans or climax sounds. Voice sets are in Data\F4SE\Plugins\4Stim\Voice Sets\ (docs/SOUND.md).
$4Stim_MCM_moanVolume_Help: Moan and climax volume, 0 to 1 (OStim's moanVolume).
$4Stim_MCM_soundVolume_Help: Volume of action sounds (slaps, strokes) and event sounds (spanks), 0 to 1 (OStim's soundVolume). Actions play them on their peaks (docs/EVENTS.md).
$4Stim_MCM_iSoundPriority_Help: How sound files play (Fallout 4's audio usage flags and priority, 0-255). Leave these unless sounds don't play; then check 4Stim.log.
$4Stim_MCM_sMaleLight_Help: A light on each actor during scenes, as OStim's light equip objects: a file name in Data\F4SE\Plugins\4Stim\Lights\, without .json (docs/LIGHTS.md): facelight, facelightdim, crotchlight, crotchlightdim, asslight, asslightdim, or nolight (OStim's default).
$4Stim_MCM_sFemaleLight_Help: A light on each actor during scenes, as OStim's light equip objects: a file name in Data\F4SE\Plugins\4Stim\Lights\, without .json (docs/LIGHTS.md): facelight, facelightdim, crotchlight, crotchlightdim, asslight, asslightdim, or nolight (OStim's default).
$4Stim_MCM_SetOnlyLightInDark_Help: 1 = only when it's dark where the scene starts (OStim's SetOnlyLightInDark).
$4Stim_MCM_fLightLevelDark_Help: How dark counts as dark: the game's light level (GetLightLevel) below this. Fallout 4 reads about 70-75 in dark places at night, so 80 (OStim's 20 is Skyrim's scale). 4Stim.log gives the level at each scene start.
$4Stim_MCM_HotkeysNote: These are the MCM's own hotkeys. The keys in 4Stim.ini work too: bind each action in one place only.
$4Stim_MCM_KeyHotkey_Help: Starts a scene with whoever you look at, or in a scene focuses the HUD (4Stim.ini: SetKeyMap).
$4Stim_MCM_KeyNPCScene_Help: The picker for a scene without you (4Stim.ini: keyNpcSceneStart, or Shift + the hotkey).
$4Stim_MCM_KeySpeedUp_Help: The scene you're in one speed faster (4Stim.ini: SetKeyUp).
$4Stim_MCM_KeySpeedDown_Help: The scene you're in one speed slower (4Stim.ini: SetKeyDown).
$4Stim_MCM_KeyAutoMode_Help: Auto mode for the scene you're in or watching (4Stim.ini: SetControlToggle).
$4Stim_MCM_KeyEnd_Help: Ends the scene you're in or watching (4Stim.ini: SetOsaEndKey).
$4Stim_MCM_KeySearch_Help: Every scene for these actors (4Stim.ini: keySearch).
$4Stim_MCM_KeyAlign_Help: Opens the HUD's Align tab (4Stim.ini: keyAlignment).
$4Stim_MCM_KeyFreeCam_Help: In and out of the free camera in a scene (4Stim.ini: SetFreeCamToggleKey).
$4Stim_MCM_KeyHideUI_Help: Hides or shows the HUD (4Stim.ini: keyHideUI).
$4Stim_MCM_SettingsNote: Settings changed here are kept in Data\MCM\Settings\4Stim.ini, over 4Stim.ini. Whichever of the two you changed last wins when the game starts.
$4Stim_MCM_IniOnly: Only in 4Stim.ini: the undress slots (sUndressSlots), bone names (sPenisBendNode, sLeftEyeNode, sRightEyeNode) and sound flags (iSoundFlags).
$4Stim_MCM_Export_Help: The settings in effect to Documents\My Games\Fallout4\4Stim\mcmsettings.json, as OStim exports its own.
$4Stim_MCM_UseIni_Help: Forgets what was changed here: 4Stim.ini's values again.
$4Stim_MCM_Intro: OStim NG for Fallout 4. Every setting is also in Data\F4SE\Plugins\4Stim.ini.
